name: Areas of Gray
source:
A middle-aged writer moved to a new apartment in a giant skyscraper. He couldn't even imagine what awaits him and his loved ones. And what secrets are hidden behind the walls...​

[From [url=https://www.notvil.com/2018/12/areas-of-gray-videogames.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
一位中年作家搬进巨型摩天大楼里的一间新公寓。他完全无法想象，自己与所爱之人即将面对什么。那些墙壁背后，又藏着怎样的秘密……

[摘自[url=https://www.notvil.com/2018/12/areas-of-gray-videogames.html]官方网站[/url]]
